title: Illinois Hospital Uninsured Patient Discount Act (210 ILCS 89)

rules.title: Uninsured discounts up to 600% FPL (UNVERIFIED)
rules.plain: Illinois hospitals must discount bills for uninsured residents up to 600% of the poverty line, and give free care up to 200%. Not yet checked against the official text.
rules.notes: ilga.gov was down (503, then connection refused) on 2026-10-18. Figures from secondary summaries only: 600% FPL non-rural, 300% rural/critical access, 100% at 200% (125% rural), apply within 60 days. Do not use in the audit until verified.
